text_en: When the Lord your God has cut off the nations whose land the Lord your God is giving you, and you have dispossessed them and settled in their towns and in their houses,
text_cn: 当上主你天主消灭了那些异民，上主你的天主将他们的土地赐给了你，而你占领了那地，住在他们的城镇和房屋里以后，

text_en: you shall set apart three cities in the land that the Lord your God is giving you to possess.
text_cn: 应在上主你的天主赐给你作产业的地方，划出三座城，

text_en: You shall calculate the distances and divide into three regions the land that the Lord your God gives you as a possession, so that any homicide can flee to one of them.
text_cn: 修好到那里去的道路，将上主你的天主给你作产业的地方，分为三个区域，这样使杀了人的，可逃到那里去。

text_en: Now this is the case of a homicide who might flee there and live, that is, someone who has killed another person unintentionally when the two had not been at enmity before:
text_cn: 杀人犯逃到那里得保全性命的案件应是这样：假使有人无意杀了邻人，彼此又素无仇怨：

text_en: Suppose someone goes into the forest with another to cut wood, and when one of them swings the ax to cut down a tree, the head slips from the handle and strikes the other person who then dies; the killer may flee to one of these cities and live.
text_cn: 比如他与邻人同去林中伐树，当他手挥斧子伐树时，斧头脱了柄，落在邻人身上，以致毙命，他就可逃到这些城中的一座城去，为保全性命，

text_en: But if the distance is too great, the avenger of blood in hot anger might pursue and overtake and put the killer to death, although a death sentence was not deserved, since the two had not been at enmity before.
text_cn: 以免报血仇者心中发火追赶杀人者，因路途遥远，而能赶上他，将他杀死；其实他与那人素无仇怨，罪不该死。

text_en: Therefore I command you: You shall set apart three cities.
text_cn: 为此我吩咐你：应划出三座城。

text_en: If the Lord your God enlarges your territory, as he swore to your ancestors—and he will give you all the land that he promised your ancestors to give you,
text_cn: 当上主你的天主，照他向你的祖先誓许的，扩展了你的疆域，将许下要给你祖先的整个土地赐给你时，──

text_en: provided you diligently observe this entire commandment that I command you today, by loving the Lord your God and walking always in his ways—then you shall add three more cities to these three,
text_cn: 倘若你谨守遵行我今日吩咐你的这一切诫命，爱上主你的天主，日日履行他的道路，──你应在这三座城以外，另设三座城，

text_en: so that the blood of an innocent person may not be shed in the land that the Lord your God is giving you as an inheritance, thereby bringing bloodguilt upon you.
text_cn: 免得无罪者的血，流在上主你的天主赐给你作产业的土地上，血债归在你身上。

text_en: But if someone at enmity with another lies in wait and attacks and takes the life of that person, and flees into one of these cities,
text_cn: 但是，如果有人怀恨自己的邻人，埋伏突袭他，而将他杀死，然后逃到这些城中的一座，

text_en: then the elders of the killer’s city shall send to have the culprit taken from there and handed over to the avenger of blood to be put to death.
text_cn: 他本城的长老应派人去，将他从那里逮回，交于报血仇者手中，将他处死；

text_en: Show no pity; you shall purge the guilt of innocent blood from Israel, so that it may go well with you.
text_cn: 你不可怜视他，而应由以色列中洗除无辜的血：如此你才能平安无事。

text_en: You must not move your neighbor’s boundary marker, set up by former generations, on the property that will be allotted to you in the land that the Lord your God is giving you to possess.
text_cn: 在上主你的天主赐给你作产业所分得的土地上，不可移动你邻人的地界，因为是先人所划定的。

text_en: A single witness shall not suffice to convict a person of any crime or wrongdoing in connection with any offense that may be committed. Only on the evidence of two or three witnesses shall a charge be sustained.
text_cn: 人无论犯了什么不义，什么罪恶，或什么过错，只凭一个见证，罪名不得成立；须凭两个或三个见证的口供，才可定案。

text_en: If a malicious witness comes forward to accuse someone of wrongdoing,
text_cn: 若有人怀有恶意，起来作证控告某人犯法，

text_en: then both parties to the dispute shall appear before the Lord , before the priests and the judges who are in office in those days,
text_cn: 二人应一同站在上主面前，和值班的司祭及判官面前。

text_en: and the judges shall make a thorough inquiry. If the witness is a false witness, having testified falsely against another,
text_cn: 判官应仔细考问。若那作证的是一个假证人，诬告自己的兄弟，

text_en: then you shall do to the false witness just as the false witness had meant to do to the other. So you shall purge the evil from your midst.
text_cn: 你就应对付他，如同他想对付自己的兄弟一样：这样你便由你中间铲除了这邪恶，

text_en: The rest shall hear and be afraid, and a crime such as this shall never again be committed among you.
text_cn: 其余的人听了，必然害怕，在你中间再不致有这样的恶事发生。

text_en: Show no pity: life for life, eye for eye, tooth for tooth, hand for hand, foot for foot.
text_cn: 你不可发慈悲，要以命偿命，以眼还眼，以牙还牙，以手还手，以脚还脚。
